title.narrative: Integrated multi-sector Lifesaving support to contested areas in May Tsebri town and Laelay Tselemti/Dima woredas

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims to respond to immediate lifesaving needs of people suffering from conflict and drought in Laelay Tselemti/Dema woreda and May Tsebri town with limited access to basic services provided from the humanitarian partners and governmental structures. The multi sectoral and integrated response in alignment with the 3rd reserve allocation of EHF-2024 covers the sectors of Nutrition, WASH and ESNFI to address needs of conflict affected IDPs/ Returnees communities. ltspangtThe integrated intervention will address the Nutrition section plans to provide lifesaving nutrition interventions by the integration of CMAM and IYCF-E activities through the existing health system. lt/spangtltspangtThe WASH component will enable vulnerable community Living in May Tsebri have access to life saving safe water supply including WASH NFI and household water treatment chemicals and sanitation service with hygiene practices and subsequently contribute for reduction of morbidity and mortality related with lack of access to safe WASH service. The main objective of WASH programs response is to reduce public health risks and scope of activities are : promoting good hygiene practices, providing safe drinking water providing appropriate sanitation facilities r educing environmental health risks and ensuring conditions that allow people to live with good health, dignity, comfort and safety. lt/spangtltspangt Whereas tlt/spangtltspangthe ESNFI Component lt/spangtltspangtprovide safe, appropriate, and critical lifesaving Emergency Shelter and nonfood items to displacement affected and improve the living conditions, physical protection, and safety of the displaced. NFI assistance for disabled and elderly supports restoring and maintaining health, dignity and safety and undertaking daily domestic activities in and around the home. lt/spangtltspangtTimely shelter, settlements support can save lives in the initial stages of crisis. In addition to providing protection from weather, shelter is necessary to promote health, support family and community life, and provide dignity, security and access to livelihoods.lt/spangtltspangtFurthermore, MCMDO will ensure strong coordination with other humanitarian partners in the Cluster System. lt/spangtltspangtThe project will target 47,675 (Women 22331, Girls 4,284, Men 19,023 and Boys 4467) beneficiaries for the period of 12 months with a total budget of USD 900,000.00.lt/spangtlt/pgt
